# {{ site.data.profile.name }}

> {{ site.description }}

{{ site.data.profile.name }} is a {% include jobtitle %} at {{ site.data.profile.employer }}, based in {{ site.data.profile.city }}, India. His scientific contributions added over USD 550M to Amazon revenue (2021-2026). He holds an M.S. in Computer Science (thesis track) from The University of Texas at Austin, advised by Prof. Greg Durrett. Contact: via LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/in/ardivekar). Google Scholar: {{ site.data.profile.google_scholar }}
